summary: This document provides an overview of software tools relevant to extending SAWNERGY for machine learning on molecular-dynamics (MD) trajectories. It categorizes tools into trajectory-analysis, machine-learning, dynamical/kinetic modeling, residue-interaction-network, generative conformational-modeling, and adaptive-simulation workflows. Key projects include MDAnalysis, mdlearn, DeepDriveMD, deeptime, gRINN/i-gRINN, RinPy, molearn, enspara, and PyEMMA. No single tool covers the entire MD-to-ML-to-kinetics pipeline; integration is common. Well-established solutions exist for trajectory access, contact-map latent spaces, slow-dynamics modeling, force-field energetic decomposition, and residue-network analysis. SAWNERGY's distinctive niche is learning time-dependent, physically meaningful residue-residue representations to capture nonlocal mutation-induced dynamics. title: MD / ML Software Landscape Relevant to SAWNERGY
